tools.name: base_block_number
tools.description: Get the current Base mainnet block number (latest chain height) for an autonomous agent. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: base_gas_price
tools.description: Get the current gas price on Base mainnet in wei for transaction fee estimation. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: base_wallet_balance
tools.description: Check the native ETH balance of a wallet or address on Base mainnet. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: base_erc20_balance
tools.description: Check a USDC or other ERC-20 token balance for a wallet on Base mainnet. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: base_nonce
tools.description: Get the current transaction nonce for a Base wallet before broadcasting a transaction. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: base_contract_code
tools.description: Check whether an address is a smart contract or EOA on Base mainnet by reading deployed bytecode. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: base_allowance
tools.description: Check an ERC-20 token allowance on Base for an owner and spender. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: base_receipt
tools.description: Check whether a Base transaction succeeded, get its receipt, and count current confirmations. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: base_logs
tools.description: Query smart-contract event logs on Base by contract address, topics and bounded block range. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: base_eth_call
tools.description: Make a read-only smart-contract call on Base with eth_call without sending a transaction. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: base_transaction
tools.description: Get a full Base transaction by hash, including sender, recipient, value, calldata and live transaction details. Costs $0.008 USDC via x402.

tools.name: base_block
tools.description: Get a Base block by number or tag with its header and transaction hashes. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: base_transaction_context
tools.description: Use when an agent needs one-call Base transaction context to verify a payment, debug a failed transaction, or confirm settlement. Costs $0.008 USDC via x402.

tools.name: base_wallet_snapshot
tools.description: Take a Base wallet snapshot in one call: native ETH plus up to 10 supplied ERC-20 token balances. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: base_total_supply
tools.description: Get total supply for an ERC-20 token or ERC-721 NFT contract on Base. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: base_contract_info
tools.description: Inspect a Base smart contract and get token metadata, bytecode size and common interface detection in one call. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: base_erc20_transfers
tools.description: Find recent ERC-20 transfers on Base, optionally filtered to transfers from or to a specific wallet. Costs $0.005 USDC via x402.
